title: Final Project Rubric
purpose: Assess scientific explanation, not coding sophistication.

criteria.name: conceptual_accuracy
criteria.description: Correctly connects neuron shape, ions/channels, voltage, spikes, timing, and noise.

levels.emerging: Describes pieces separately or with major errors.
levels.developing: Gives a mostly correct story but misses one key link.
levels.proficient: Correctly connects neuron shape, voltage, spikes, timing, and noise.
levels.strong: Explains the causal chain clearly and can answer a follow-up question.

criteria.name: correct_graph_labeling_and_figure_interpretation
criteria.description: Labels axes, units, conditions, and uses the graph as evidence.

levels.emerging: Figure lacks key labels or the student cannot explain it.
levels.developing: Labels are partly correct but interpretation is incomplete.
levels.proficient: Axes, units, conditions, and visual pattern are clear.
levels.strong: Uses the figure as evidence and notes what it does not show.

criteria.name: correct_use_of_terms
criteria.description: Uses core terms accurately, including V_m, spike train, ISI, CV, model, and limitation.

levels.emerging: Terms are missing or used incorrectly.
levels.developing: Uses most terms correctly with prompting.
levels.strong: Defines terms in student-friendly language while using them precisely.

criteria.name: timing_metric_calculation
criteria.description: Correctly calculates and interprets at least one timing metric.

levels.emerging: Calculation is missing or has major sign/unit errors.
levels.developing: Calculation is mostly correct but interpretation is weak.
levels.proficient: At least one timing metric is correct and interpreted.
levels.strong: Calculation is correct, labeled, and used as evidence in the claim.

criteria.name: limitation_explanation
criteria.description: Explains what the model or evidence does not prove.

levels.emerging: No limitation or only says it might be wrong.
levels.proficient: States a clear limitation of the simplified model.
levels.strong: Explains why the limitation matters and suggests a reasonable next step.

criteria.name: model_output_vs_biological_evidence
criteria.description: Distinguishes simulation output from direct biological evidence.

levels.emerging: Treats simulation output as direct proof about real neurons.
levels.developing: Partly distinguishes model and biology but overclaims.
levels.proficient: Clearly says what is model output and what would count as biological evidence.
levels.strong: Compares model, cartoon, and real data carefully without overclaiming.

score_bands.label: strong
score_bands.meaning: Clear evidence-based explanation with careful limits.

score_bands.label: proficient
score_bands.meaning: Scientifically sound and presentation-ready after minor edits.

score_bands.label: developing
score_bands.meaning: Useful work, but needs revision in graph use, calculation, or limitation.

score_bands.label: emerging
score_bands.meaning: Return to the chapter checks before presenting.
